title: Mass Quizball — Grand Final
description: All four houses face off across five rounds of science, technology and engineering questions. Buzzers, rapid fire and a double-points final round. Bring your loudest supporters.

title: Zeus Energy Lab: Building Electromagnets
description: Wind your own coil, measure the field strength with a Hall probe and plot the relationship between current and magnetic flux density. Safety goggles required.

title: Poseidon Spin Tank Challenge
description: Design a hull that survives the spin tank without shipping water. Points for stability, payload carried and the least water taken on over three timed runs.

title: Athena Robotics Sprint: Line Followers
description: Teams of three tune a two-sensor line follower around the track. Fastest clean lap takes maximum points, with a bonus for the tidiest wiring.

title: Aphrodite Molecular Modelling & Fibonacci Art
description: Build a 3D model of an organic molecule of your choice, then submit a Fibonacci-inspired poster proving where the golden ratio hides in nature.

title: Deadline: Week 2 Lab Reports
description: Every house uploads its week 2 lab reports to the STE portal. Late submissions forfeit the completion bonus, so file early.

title: STE Project Showcase & Closing Ceremony
description: Every house exhibits its flagship build to the judges and the visiting primary school. The STE Cup is awarded at 13:00 — the largest single points haul of the week.
